notes: Lithuanian: mėgti expresses a general or habitual liking; Aš mėgstu skaityti — I enjoy reading. With a noun, use the accusative: Aš mėgstu kavą. Overlaps with patikti (like, L3), which uses a dative experiencer: Man patinka kava. The preference/reaction distinction is a tendency, not an absolute rule. Distinct teaching target from enjoy (take pleasure in an experience), mėgautis, L260.
